title: Flynn Stressful Conversations V2
purpose: High-stakes conversation preparation, fact discipline, calibrated techniques, boundaries, medium choice, and documentation.

source_boundary.rule: Direct claims require a supplied-source locator. Applied records must identify themselves as extensions.

records.title: High-stakes conversation intake
records.rule: Before drafting or scripting, separate facts, interpretations, assumptions, and emotional tension; define stakes, power, desired resolution, boundaries, face needs, and documentation need.
decision_logic: Block scripting if facts and interpretations are collapsed.
Choose live, written, or hybrid handling from interaction, safety, and documentation needs.
Define a realistic resolution and non-negotiable boundary.
guardrails: Avoid mind-reading and unnecessary accusation.
Do not bury the difficult fact.
Do not rely on phrasing alone where safety, abuse, legal, or HR processes are implicated.

locator.value: 174-189; Taking the Stress Out of Stressful Conversations

source_support.paraphrased_support_note: Weeks emphasizes self-awareness, preparation, and situational techniques rather than improvisation under emotional load.
Flynn V1 makes standards and corrective actions clear without accusation.
Garner cautions against writing in anger and misleadingly soft openings for bad news.
